sections.title: Part I: System Usability and User Experience (SOP 4)

questions.text: How often did you experience technical issues (lag, crashes, difficulty navigating) while using the desktop simulation?

options.choice: A. Never. The system ran perfectly.
B. Rarely (1-2 minor issues).
C. Occasionally (The system was disruptive at times).
D. Frequently (Significantly hindered the experience).

questions.text: The visual design and user interface of StrandVenture made the exploration process easy and intuitive.

options.choice: A. Highly intuitive; I learned to use it instantly.
B. Mostly intuitive; only minor difficulty at first.
C. Somewhat confusing; required effort to figure out.
D. Very confusing; the interface hindered my exploration.

questions.text: How does StrandVenture compare to traditional counseling methods you have previously experienced?

options.choice: A. Much better (More personalized and informative).
B. Slightly better (More engaging, but similar information).
C. About the same (No major difference).
D. Worse (Less helpful than face-to-face counseling).

sections.title: Part II: Engagement and Experiential Learning (SOP 3)

questions.text: How accurately did the simulation reflect the real-world tasks of the recommended strand (e.g., lab work for STEM, accounting tasks for ABM)?

options.choice: A. Highly accurate; felt like a real experience.
B. Mostly accurate, with a few minor unrealistic elements.
C. Somewhat accurate, but lacked depth in key areas.
D. Not accurate; felt generic and unrealistic.

questions.text: The simulation environment (graphics, sound, interaction) felt immersive and helped me stay motivated.

options.choice: A. Highly immersive; I forgot I was on a desktop.
B. Moderately immersive; kept me engaged.
C. Slightly distracting; the environment was basic.
D. Not immersive; it felt dull and did not help my learning.

questions.text: How did the simulation impact your interest in the recommended academic strand?

options.choice: A. Greatly increased my interest and motivation.
B. Slightly increased my interest.
C. Did not change my level of interest.
D. Decreased my interest.

questions.text: Which aspect of the simulation was most helpful in your exploration?

options.choice: A. Strand Simulation
B. Taking the exam
C. Job Expo Simulation
D. The Visualization of Recommendation/Feedback.

sections.title: Part III: Confidence and Recommendation Quality (SOP 4)

questions.text: After the simulation, how confident are you in your final choice of academic strand?

options.choice: A. Extremely confident (Decision is clear and firm).
B. Moderately confident (Slight doubts remain).
C. Slightly confident (Still highly uncertain).
D. Not confident at all (Need further guidance).

questions.text: The recommendation provided by StrandVenture affirmed my understanding of my own strengths and weaknesses.

options.choice: A. Strongly affirmed my self-awareness.
B. Somewhat affirmed my self-awareness.
C. Neutral; provided no new insight into my abilities.
D. Contradicted what I know about myself.

questions.text: I would rely on the StrandVenture recommendation over guidance from peers or family members.

options.choice: A. Definitely rely on StrandVenture more.
B. Would weigh both equally.
C. Would rely on peers/family more.
D. Would ignore the StrandVenture recommendation.
